name: price_native
description: SDAC day-ahead prices at native resolution with EUR conversion. One series per zone (AT and DE_LU use the SDAC sequence of the registry).

columns.name: zone_key
columns.description: Bidding zone key from the zone registry.

columns.name: timestamp_local
columns.description: Slot start in the zone timezone.

columns.name: resolution
columns.description: ISO 8601 resolution of the source: PT15M, PT30M or PT60M.

columns.name: price_local
columns.description: Price in the publication currency per MWh.

columns.name: fx_units_per_eur
columns.description: ECB units of currency per EUR used for the conversion; null for EUR or when missing.

columns.name: fx_rate_date
columns.description: Date of the ECB rate used.

columns.name: price_eur
columns.description: Price in EUR/MWh; null only when the rate is missing.

columns.name: is_a03_filled
columns.description: True when the slot comes from A03 expansion.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Calendar year of the UTC timestamp (partition column).

constraints: price_eur IS NOT NULL OR fx_status = 'missing_rate'
